name: ui-ux-ultra-max-skill
description: Makes Claude design like a senior product designer: a real persona, 5–8 named UX laws and psychology principles, rendered screens with every state, and automated accessibility checks, and an independent 3-member review council before hand-over. Works for non-designers too.

optional.ui-ux-pro-max: Correctness checks and stack rules (per-stack guidance, pre-delivery checklist). Used when installed; built-in WCAG checks and scripts/audit.sh otherwise.
